title: Agent experience: --json and stable exit codes on every command, and a ticfac skill
description: Every command gets --json (versioned) and a documented exit code set that separates done, running, held-for-a-person (with the reason class), failed and usage errors, so an agent never parses prose. Then the ticfac skill: the loop (init, doctor, run, the overview, triage) in about twenty lines, installed like tk's ('ticfac skills install ticfac'). It states its boundary with the ticks skill: ticks owns planning and tick shape, ticfac owns execution.
notes: 2026-09-27 11:21 - Operator, 2026-09-27: property testing fits the CLI and TUI well. When Hegel is back (after r6w's Go bump), add properties for the command surface: for generated argument sequences and run states, every command with --json emits one document that parses against its versioned schema; the exit code is always one of the documented set and agrees with the JSON's state; and no --json output ever writes to stderr. The TUI side (89m's watch, 2qz's overview, i1r's page) is Bombadil's, noted on the epic.
acceptance_criteria: Every command has --json and the exit code table is documented and tested; the skill installs with one command; an agent session with only the two skills runs an epic from start to close; the skills do not contradict each other
